parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: Password of the user to login into OpenNebula OneFlow API server. If not set then the value of the ONEFLOW_PASSWORD environment variable is used.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: URL of the OpenNebula OneFlow API server. It is recommended to use HTTPS so that the username/password are not transferred over the network unencrypted. If not set then the value of the ONEFLOW_URL environment variable is used.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: Name of the user to login into the OpenNebula OneFlow API server. If not set then the value of the ONEFLOW_USERNAME environment variable is used.

parameters.name: cardinality
parameters.description: Number of VMs for the specified role.

parameters.name: custom_attrs
parameters.description: Dictionary of key/value custom attributes which is used when instantiating a new service. Default: {}

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force the new cardinality even if it is outside the limits. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: ID of the group which is set as the group of the service.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Set permission mode of a service instance in octet format, for example 0600 to give owner use and manage and nothing to group and others.

parameters.name: owner_id
parameters.description: ID of the user which is set as the owner of the service.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Name of the role whose cardinality should be changed.

parameters.name: service_id
parameters.description: ID of a service instance that you would like to manage.

parameters.name: service_name
parameters.description: Name of a service instance that you would like to manage.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: present - instantiate a service from a template specified with template_id or template_name. absent - terminate an instance of a service specified with template_id or template_name. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: template_id
parameters.description: ID of a service template to use to create a new instance of a service.

parameters.name: template_name
parameters.description: Name of service template to use to create a new instance of a service.

parameters.name: unique
parameters.description: Setting unique=true ensures that there is only one service instance running with a name set with service_name when instantiating a service from a template specified with template_id or template_name. Check examples below. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for the instance to reach RUNNING state after DEPLOYING or COOLDOWN state after SCALING. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds. Default: 300

examples:
- name: Instantiate a new service
  community.general.one_service:
    template_id: 90
  register: result

- name: Print service properties
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: result

- name: Instantiate a new service with specified service_name, service group and mode
  community.general.one_service:
    template_name: 'app1_template'
    service_name: 'app1'
    group_id: 1
    mode: '660'

- name: Instantiate a new service with template_id and pass custom_attrs dict
  community.general.one_service:
    template_id: 90
    custom_attrs:
      public_network_id: 21
      private_network_id: 26

- name: Instantiate a new service 'foo' if the service doesn't already exist, otherwise do nothing
  community.general.one_service:
    template_id: 53
    service_name: 'foo'
    unique: true

- name: Delete a service by ID
  community.general.one_service:
    service_id: 153
    state: absent

- name: Get service info
  community.general.one_service:
    service_id: 153
  register: service_info

- name: Change service owner, group and mode
  community.general.one_service:
    service_name: 'app2'
    owner_id: 34
    group_id: 113
    mode: '600'

- name: Instantiate service and wait for it to become RUNNING
  community.general.one_service:
    template_id: 43
    service_name: 'foo1'

- name: Wait service to become RUNNING
  community.general.one_service:
    service_id: 112
    wait: true

- name: Change role cardinality
  community.general.one_service:
    service_id: 153
    role: bar
    cardinality: 5

- name: Change role cardinality and wait for it to be applied
  community.general.one_service:
    service_id: 112
    role: foo
    cardinality: 7
    wait: true

return_values.name: group_id
return_values.description: Service’s group ID. Returned: success Sample: 1

return_values.name: group_name
return_values.description: Service’s group name. Returned: success Sample: "one-users"

return_values.name: owner_id
return_values.description: Service’s owner ID. Returned: success Sample: 143

return_values.name: owner_name
return_values.description: Service’s owner name. Returned: success Sample: "ansible-test"

return_values.name: roles
return_values.description: List of dictionaries of roles, each role is described by name, cardinality, state and nodes IDs. Returned: success Sample: [{"cardinality": 1, "ids": [123, 456], "name": "foo", "state": "RUNNING"}, {"cardinality": 2, "ids": [452, 567, 746], "name": "bar", "state": "RUNNING"}]

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: State of service instance. Returned: success Sample: "RUNNING"
